purpose: Resolve observed subsecond missed possessions with a 25Hz temporal expert; original features computed at every frame, not interpolated.
train: Same four non-held matches, 3 sensor regimes and team mirroring; 800 boundary-TCN updates, seed2029, original architecture/optimizer; 384-frame windows now 15.36s, boundary supervision radius now .08s.
selection: Highest selection spellF1 with macro>=baseline-.002; freeze then test selected only on fold2; adopt if both confirmation game means improve and macro>=baseline-.002.
limitation: Previously used external matches, not untouched final test.
